region.name: the Ravenmarch
region.blurb: Golden fields in the west, misty bogs and old oak woods in the middle, and in the east the pirate-held port of Saltmouth.

towns.name: Lionbridge
towns.blurb: The royal city of the Ravenmarch: white walls, red roofs, and a castle flying the Queen's banners.

mayor.name: Mayor Fenella
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: tall, thin mayor with dark curls, a mustard-yellow waistcoat, and a walking stick topped with a silver fox
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Lionbridge.
Anything you need, ask. The Queen's champion is welcome everywhere in Lionbridge.

quest.title: A Book of Songs for Miremere
offer: Would you carry this book of songs to Duchess Olwen in Miremere? It is for their choir. They have been singing the same three songs for years.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Duchess Olwen in Miremere is waiting for the book of songs.
done: New songs, at last! The choir will be thrilled. The neighbours, less so.

shop.name: The Busy Bee

keeper.name: Edmund
keeper.avatar: kindly old shopkeeper in half-moon spectacles and a knitted waistcoat

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: The Mill Wheel Workshop

keeper.name: Bertram
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Beatrix
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: Have you ever fought a grey wolf? What was it like?
When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Sergeant Morgan
npcs.avatar: grizzled town guard in a dented steel cap, leaning on a halberd
lines: Arms up, chin down, hit hard.
I can train you, for a few coins.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Rusty Key.

towns.name: Saltmouth
towns.blurb: Merchant ships sit burnt at the quay, and a skull-and-crossbones flies over the harbour tower.

mayor.name: Duke Tam
mayor.title: Duke
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful duke with a bald head that shines, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a silver circlet
greeting: Psst! In here, quick, before they see you. The Queen sent you?
Captain Storm rules the town from a black ship out in the bay. We pay them every week, or they burn a warehouse.

shop.name: The Stubborn Stall

keeper.name: Hazel
keeper.avatar: brisk shopkeeper with a pencil behind one ear and a ledger under one arm

lines: I'm staying till the end. Buy what you need; you'll need it.

workshop.name: The Last Forge

keeper.name: Theobald
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: Everyone else has fled. The anvil's all yours.

npcs.name: Old Mabel
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Everyone keeps telling me to run. Run where? My knees are eighty-three.
Stormcaller, the Admiral's Coat and the Map of Skull Cove. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Wystan
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: They took my lantern. And my hat. And my other hat.
Every night they sing sea shanties. Badly. Very loudly.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Miremere
towns.blurb: Lantern-lit walkways wind between the houses over dark, still water. Frogs sing all night.

mayor.name: Duchess Olwen
mayor.title: Duchess
mayor.avatar: elegant duchess with a long golden plait, a sea-green robe, and a very large hat
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Miremere.
Mind the boardwalks. Some of the planks are, well, optional.

quest.title: An Ore Sample for Heatherdale
offer: Would you carry this ore sample to Lord Merrick in Heatherdale? We have struck a new seam, and they want to see a sample.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Lord Merrick in Heatherdale is waiting for the ore sample.
done: Beautiful! Look at that silver. Miremere will be rich.

shop.name: Dunstan's Curios

keeper.name: Dunstan
keeper.avatar: kindly old shopkeeper in half-moon spectacles and a knitted waistcoat

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: Crispin's Brewhouse

keeper.name: Crispin
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: The cauldron never stops bubbling. Put something good in it.

npcs.name: Herbalist Tilly
npcs.avatar: herbalist in a green apron, with bundles of drying herbs hanging from the belt
lines: Every potion is a little poem, if you know how to read it.
Lessons are cheap. Not knowing is expensive.
The Mill Gear from Rowanglen is hidden in the Reed Maze in Miremere.

npcs.name: Yvaine
npcs.avatar: lean ferry-keeper in a wide hat, leaning on a long pole
lines: I take anyone across. Except goblins. Goblins don't tip.
Pirates fear nothing like a storm at sea.

spots.name: the Reed Maze
spots.text: At the heart of the reeds, on a muddy tussock: the Mill Gear.

towns.name: Hazelgrove
towns.blurb: Cottages with mossy roofs hide among the trees. Fireflies light the lanes at night.

mayor.name: Warden Rowan
mayor.title: Warden
mayor.avatar: small, brisk warden with wild curly hair, a green velvet coat, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Hazelgrove welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
The trees here are older than the kingdom. Be kind to them.

quest.title: The Silver Bell
offer: Our Silver Bell was stolen! We ring it when the river floods.
A goblin ran off toward Silverfell with it. Bring it back and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Silver Bell? A goblin ran off toward Silverfell with it.
done: My bell! Now we'll hear the floods coming.

shop.name: The Mossy Kettle

keeper.name: Egbert
keeper.avatar: cheerful bald merchant in a honey-coloured vest

lines: Everything a traveller needs, and a few things they don't.

workshop.name: The Sawdust Hut

keeper.name: Emery
keeper.avatar: cheerful tinker with a tool belt full of odd little tools

lines: The grindstone sings when you pedal fast. Make it sing!

npcs.name: Granny Agatha
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Not all witches are wicked, dearie.
The Silver Bell from Hazelgrove is hidden in the Abandoned Mine in Silverfell.

npcs.name: Old Odette
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: I remember the last time Everwyn needed a hero. You look taller than that one.
Eat something! You're all bones.

spots.name: the Fairy Ring
spots.text: In the middle of the ring of mushrooms lies a Greater Healing Draught. You hear tiny giggles.

towns.name: Heatherdale
towns.blurb: A hill town of orchards and stone walls, with a view over half of the Ravenmarch.

mayor.name: Lord Merrick
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed lord with a red beard braided with beads, a patched but proud coat, and a silver circlet
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Heatherdale.
Have some cheese. Everyone here has cheese.

quest.title: A Bolt of Blue Cloth for Willowwater
offer: Would you carry this bolt of blue cloth to Baker Gus in Willowwater? It is for their festival banner. They can't finish it without the blue.
You'll be well paid for your trouble.
quest.reminder: Baker Gus in Willowwater is waiting for the bolt of blue cloth.
done: The blue cloth! Now the banner will be done in time.

shop.name: The Crooked Crook

keeper.name: Ivor
keeper.avatar: kindly old shopkeeper in half-moon spectacles and a knitted waistcoat

lines: Wool, cheese and cudgels: the three things every hill-walker needs.

workshop.name: The Hilltop Forge

keeper.name: Robin
keeper.avatar: patient glassblower with singed sleeves and careful hands

lines: Everything I own, I made right here. So can you.

npcs.name: Ranger Hugo
npcs.avatar: hooded ranger with a longbow and a scar across one cheek
lines: The wild wears you down, if you let it.
I can toughen you up, if you've the coin.
Only an Admiral's Coat can turn Captain Storm's fire. Hollis's Curios in Willowwater has one.

npcs.name: Jory
npcs.avatar: small child with scabby knees and a pet frog in one pocket
lines: Have you ever fought a road bandit? What was it like?
When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!

spots.name: the Shepherd's Hut
spots.text: Under a pile of old fleeces in the hut: a pearl!

towns.name: Rowanglen
towns.blurb: A woodcutters' village in a clearing, where the sawmill hums and the air smells of pine.

mayor.name: Countess Sabine
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed countess with braided red hair, a sea-green robe, and a very large hat
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Rowanglen.

quest.title: The Mill Gear
offer: The mill has stopped. A gear is missing, and without it we can't grind a thing.
The miller's boy says a troll took it to Miremere to wear as a hat. Bring it back and the Map of Skull Cove, which has been in my family for generations, is yours.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Mill Gear? The miller's boy says a troll took it to Miremere to wear as a hat.
done: The gear! The mill will be turning again by supper.
As promised: the Map of Skull Cove. May it serve you well against Captain Storm.

shop.name: The Acorn & Arrow

keeper.name: Marigold
keeper.avatar: stubborn young shopkeeper with a smudged face and a lantern

lines: Everything a traveller needs, and a few things they don't.

workshop.name: The Whittled Owl

keeper.name: Coralie
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: Bark, sap and elbow grease. Help yourself to the bench.

npcs.name: Granny Delphine
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: My cat says you have a kind face. My cat is never wrong.
The Mill Gear from Rowanglen is hidden in the Reed Maze in Miremere.

npcs.name: Digby
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: Never swat a bee. It only makes the others cross.
The quickest road to Saltmouth is the one from Rowanglen.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: a Spider Silk!

towns.name: Silverfell
towns.blurb: A walled town on a crag, guarding the only pass through the mountains.

mayor.name: Mayor Lark
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful mayor with a long golden plait, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a silver circlet
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Silverfell.
Watch your step. Our streets mostly go up.

quest.title: Honey for a Cough
offer: My granddaughter has a cough, and honey is the only cure she'll take.
The Crooked Crook in Heatherdale sells honey, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found a jar of honey? The Crooked Crook in Heatherdale sells honey.
done: Honey! She'll be well in no time.

shop.name: Leofric's Armoury

keeper.name: Leofric
keeper.avatar: kindly old shopkeeper in half-moon spectacles and a knitted waistcoat

lines: Forged in the mountain, cooled in snowmelt. Take a look.

workshop.name: The Stonecutter's Yard

keeper.name: Zinnia
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: The best anvil this side of the mountains. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Baker Edith
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: Heroes need feeding. You look like you skipped breakfast.
The Silver Bell from Hazelgrove is hidden in the Abandoned Mine in Silverfell.

npcs.name: Nell
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: Four hundred sheep, and I know every one by name.
The Old Chest in Silverfell is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Chapel in Lionbridge years ago.

spots.name: the Abandoned Mine
spots.text: In the dark of the old shaft your hand closes on the Silver Bell.

spots.name: the Old Chest
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Vigor!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest sits in the corner, locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

towns.name: Willowwater
towns.blurb: A village of reed huts and boardwalks over the marsh. Everyone owns a punt.

mayor.name: Baroness Ida
mayor.title: Baroness
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful baroness with a long golden plait, a mustard-yellow waistcoat, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: A hero, in Willowwater! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Mind the boardwalks. Some of the planks are, well, optional.

quest.title: A Sack of Nails for Hazelgrove
offer: Would you carry this sack of nails to Granny Agatha in Hazelgrove? They are rebuilding after the storm, and they have run out of nails.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Granny Agatha in Hazelgrove is waiting for the sack of nails.
done: Nails! Now the barn roof can go back on. Thank you, Hero.

shop.name: Hollis's Curios

keeper.name: Hollis
keeper.avatar: calm shopkeeper in a green apron, with a pencil behind one ear

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: The Bog-Iron Forge

keeper.name: Bram
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: The cauldron never stops bubbling. Put something good in it.

npcs.name: Posy the Wise
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Tired of that face? I can change it. A little magic, a little gold.
Build, clothes, hair. Nothing I have not done a thousand times.
Leofric's Armoury in Silverfell sells cutlasses.

npcs.name: Baker Gus
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: Heroes need feeding. You look like you skipped breakfast.
There is a pearl hidden in the Shepherd's Hut in Heatherdale.

npcs.name: Granny Petra
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: My cat says you have a kind face. My cat is never wrong.
Countess Sabine of Rowanglen would give the Map of Skull Cove to whoever brings back the lost Mill Gear.

spots.name: the Frog Pond
spots.text: A very large frog is sitting on a Greater Healing Draught. It lets you have it, eventually.

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
enemies.taunt: Something scaly rises from the muck.

enemies.name: Cave Bats
enemies.taunt: A swarm of bats pours out of the rocks!

enemies.name: Mountain Eagle
enemies.taunt: An eagle with wings as wide as a cart dives out of the sun.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Hill Ogre
enemies.taunt: An ogre sits in the road eating a whole cabbage. It wipes its mouth and stands up.

enemies.name: Pirate Gunner
enemies.taunt: "Fire in the hole!" A pirate lights a fuse and grins.

enemies.name: Pirate Parrot
enemies.taunt: "Pieces of eight! Pieces of eight!" A parrot dives at your hat.

enemies.name: Giant Octopus
enemies.taunt: Eight long arms reach up out of a rock pool. One of them grabs your boot.

enemies.name: Giant Toad
enemies.taunt: A toad the size of a barrel blinks at you, then flicks out a very long tongue.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Captain Scarlett Storm
enemies.taunt: "Ahoy, landlubber! Ye've come a long way to walk the plank!"
enemies.avatar: towering pirate king in a coat of red velvet, with a black beard braided with gold coins

hints.text: Stormcaller can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from a cutlass with a storm-pearl set in its hilt. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.
Leofric's Armoury in Silverfell sells cutlasses.
There is a pearl hidden in the Shepherd's Hut in Heatherdale.
Hollis's Curios in Willowwater sells an Admiral's Coat. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Only an Admiral's Coat can turn Captain Storm's fire. Hollis's Curios in Willowwater has one.
Countess Sabine of Rowanglen would give the Map of Skull Cove to whoever brings back the lost Mill Gear.
The Mill Gear from Rowanglen is hidden in the Reed Maze in Miremere.
The Silver Bell from Hazelgrove is hidden in the Abandoned Mine in Silverfell.
The Old Chest in Silverfell is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Chapel in Lionbridge years ago.
To defeat Captain Storm you need Stormcaller, the Admiral's Coat and the Map of Skull Cove.
Pirates fear nothing like a storm at sea.
The quickest road to Saltmouth is the one from Rowanglen.

challenge.title: Black Sails over Saltmouth
summons: Welcome, Hero. I wish I had called you here for a feast, not a fight.
Captain Scarlett Storm and a fleet of black sails have seized Saltmouth. They rob every ship on the coast and hold the town to ransom.
Our scholars say three things can bring Captain Storm down: the cutlass Stormcaller, an Admiral's Coat against cannon-fire, and the Map of Skull Cove, which shows the way to their hideout.
Gather all three, then go to Saltmouth and face Captain Storm. Talk to everyone: somebody always knows something.
Here is gold for the road, and a few draughts. My carriage waits to take you to Lionbridge. Go with my blessing.

lair.name: Skull Cove
lair.text: A hidden cove behind the reefs, where a black-sailed ship lies at anchor.

victory: Following the Map of Skull Cove, you slip through the reefs and climb aboard the black ship.
Stormcaller brings down a squall on the deck. Captain Storm surrenders, soaked to the skin, and the crew throws down their cutlasses.
The ships of Saltmouth sail free again, and the harbour bells ring all night.
